name: BlokBlok CMS
description_en:
BlokBlok CMS is Wall-to-Wall Studios’ component-based content management system for custom-designed websites and applications. It organizes reusable content blocks inside templates and drop zones, with modules for pages, news, events and forms. Its current product site says every BlokBlok project begins with custom design and development by the agency; it is not presented as a public template marketplace or self-service subscription checkout.

Evaluate the agency implementation and the resulting editorial model together. The vendor describes a Rails/JavaScript CMS and reusable content relationships, but public sources do not establish a downloadable open-source product, a fixed price, independent hosting rights or a guaranteed set of integrations in every installation.
description_zh:
BlokBlok CMS 是 Wall-to-Wall Studios 为定制网站和应用开发的组件式内容管理系统，将可复用内容区块组织在模板和 drop zone 中，提供页面、新闻、活动和表单模块。当前产品站称每个项目都先由该机构进行定制设计开发，并未呈现为公开模板市场或自助订阅结账服务。

应同时评估机构实施和最终编辑模型。厂商描述了 Rails/JavaScript CMS 和可复用内容关系，但公开来源未确立可下载开源产品、固定价格、独立托管权利或每个安装都包含的保证集成。

core_features.explanation_en: Standard text/image/video/gallery blocks and custom types can be reused within templates or globally, such as one staff biography across several pages.
core_features.explanation_zh: 标准文字/图片/视频/图库和自定义类型可在模板内或全局复用，例如多页面共享一份员工简介。

core_features.explanation_en: Pages are flat by default; menus define navigation, page relationships and hierarchy rather than assuming a folder tree.
core_features.explanation_zh: 页面默认平铺，由菜单定义导航、关系和层级，不能假定按文件夹树组织。

core_features.name_zh: 按项目构建的内容模块
core_features.explanation_en: News, Events and Forms support specialized records; external registration/CRM integrations need explicit implementation scope.
core_features.explanation_zh: News、Events、Forms 支持专项记录，外部报名/CRM 集成需要明确实施范围。

pricing.summary_en: Custom agency design/development is the published entry route; no public numeric price, billing unit or continuing hosting/maintenance charge established. Obtain an implementation and ongoing-service quote.
pricing.summary_zh: 公开入口为机构定制设计开发，未取得公开金额、计费单位或持续托管/维护费，应取得实施及后续服务报价。

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Start with a content-model and design engagement
sections.title_zh: 从内容模型与设计委托开始
sections.en: The product site explicitly says there are no prepackaged themes: each model/design supports the brand’s goals. A useful implementation brief defines page types, reusable entities, editor roles, current URLs, forms and integrations. For example, define a Person block with name, biography and image, then specify whether edits should update every page that references it. Ask the agency to demonstrate that propagation and a recovery path in the actual installation. This is an implementation-led CMS choice, not evidence you can sign up and deploy a complete site without development.
sections.zh: 产品站明确没有预打包主题，每套模型/设计围绕品牌目标构建。有效委托应定义页面类型、可复用实体、编辑者角色、旧 URL、表单和集成。例如定义含姓名、简介和图片的 Person 区块，再明确修改是否应更新全部引用页面，要求机构在实际安装演示传播及恢复路径。这是依赖实施的 CMS 选择，不证明无需开发即可注册部署完整网站。

sections.title_en: Assemble blocks without confusing menus and pages
sections.title_zh: 组合区块并区分菜单与页面
sections.en: Templates define regions/drop zones into which editors place blocks, repeat content or reorder sections. Pages are stored on one level; site hierarchy and relationships are managed through Menus. Plan redirects and navigation separately from content creation so a new page does not accidentally acquire the wrong position or URL expectations. Standard WYSIWYG, HTML, image, video and gallery blocks are documented, while specialized products/grants/people depend on custom models. Validate what an editor may change and whether a shared block affects other pages before broad reuse.
sections.zh: 模板定义区域/drop zone，编辑者放入区块、重复内容或重排章节。页面存于同一层，站点层级和关系由 Menus 管理。应将重定向和导航与内容创建分开规划，避免新页被误认为自动获得某个位置或 URL。文档列出标准 WYSIWYG、HTML、图片、视频和图库，而商品/资助/人员等专项依赖定制模型。广泛复用前应验证编辑者能改什么，以及共享区块是否影响其他页面。

sections.title_en: Treat event registration and CRM work as integrations
sections.title_zh: 将活动报名与 CRM 工作视为集成
sections.en: News adds publication dates, authorship and categories/Sets. Events handles one-time/recurring events and venues, with registration connected to systems such as Eventbrite/Showclix rather than a documented universal native ticketing engine. Forms use configurable fields; responses can be stored in the CMS, exported and emailed. The product site names Salesforce/SugarCRM/NeonCRM/Act integration possibilities, not a supported-version matrix or automatic connector entitlement. Specify field mappings, duplicate handling, consent, notification failure and retry responsibility in the project scope; no such transaction was tested here.
sections.zh: News 增加发布日期、作者及分类/Sets。Events 管理单次/重复活动和场地，报名连接 Eventbrite/Showclix 等系统，并未证明存在普遍内置票务引擎。Forms 使用可配置字段，回复可存于 CMS、导出和邮件发送。产品站列 Salesforce/SugarCRM/NeonCRM/Act 的集成可能，不是支持版本矩阵或自动连接器权利。项目范围应明确字段映射、去重、同意、通知失败和重试责任，本次未测试这些交易。

sections.title_en: Read provider examples as scoped implementation evidence
sections.title_zh: 将厂商案例作为特定实施依据
sections.en:
The provider’s product page traces an earlier CakePHP generation and later Rails implementation; this history is not a current version/support schedule. Its P3R/Pittsburgh Marathon case describes four websites managed from one admin, sharing news/events while retaining distinct branding and URLs. That supports a concrete multi-site design pattern, not proof every BlokBlok project includes multi-site without extra work. These are vendor-authored cases, not independently verified results.

Primary sources: [provider overview](https://www.walltowall.com/pages/wall-to-wall-studios-blok-blok-cms), [P3R case](https://www.walltowall.com/pages/pittsburgh-marathon-digital).
sections.zh:
机构产品页说明早期 CakePHP 和后来的 Rails 代际，这段历史不是当前版本/支持时间表。其 P3R/匹兹堡马拉松案例描述一个后台管理四站，在不同品牌/URL 下共享新闻和活动，支持具体多站设计模式，但不证明每个项目无需额外工作就含多站。这些是厂商案例，非独立验证结果。

一手来源：[机构产品说明](https://www.walltowall.com/pages/wall-to-wall-studios-blok-blok-cms)、[P3R 案例](https://www.walltowall.com/pages/pittsburgh-marathon-digital)。

sections.title_en: Request a complete project and exit specification
sections.title_zh: 取得完整项目及退出规范
sections.en: No numeric subscription or implementation price was published in the pages read. The confirmed entry route is a custom design/development conversation with Wall-to-Wall Studios. Ask for design/build, hosting, maintenance/security updates, user/module scope, third-party fees, training and change-request pricing as separate line items. Request data/media export, source-code rights, credentials, infrastructure ownership and support/restore responsibilities before commissioning a critical site. Rails/JavaScript or use of open-source frameworks does not establish that BlokBlok itself is open source. It can fit a brand seeking bespoke design and agency delivery; a buyer needing immediate fixed-price self-service or independent installation needs more evidence. No account, demo, form, registration, export or deployment was executed.
sections.zh: 本次实读页面未发布数字订阅费或实施费，确认的入口是与 Wall-to-Wall Studios 商谈定制设计开发。应将设计/建设、托管、维护/安全更新、用户/模块范围、第三方费、培训和变更请求分项报价，关键站点委托前要求数据/媒体导出、源码权利、凭据、基础设施所有权及支持/恢复责任。使用 Rails/JavaScript 或开源框架不证明 BlokBlok 本身开源。寻求定制品牌和机构交付的企业可考虑它，需要即时固定价自助或独立安装的买方仍需更多证据。本次未执行账户、演示、表单、报名、导出或部署。
